crossRefs.note: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.
David said, “As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall go down into battle and…
When your days are fulfilled, and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed…
“Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?
For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
“Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But I came to this time for this cause.
Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the…
Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son…
He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem…
saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those…
In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.
I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against…
“I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”

translations.web: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
translations.bsb: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
